lines.beaver_en: Kim Minsu, congratulations on today's win!
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 예선에서 일등을 해서 정말 기뻐요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'm so happy I came first in the preliminaries.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. Yeseoneseo ildeungeul haeseo jeongmal gippeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was today's match? It was tough, right?
lines.en: I tied the first match, but I won in the end.

lines.beaver_en: Weren't you worried about winning or losing?
lines.learner: 승패보다 끝까지 하는 게 더 중요했어요.
lines.en: Finishing strong mattered more than the result.
lines.roman: Seungpaboda kkeutkkaji haneun ge deo jungyohaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you do other sports too?
lines.learner: 네, 유도도 하고 조정도 조금 해요.
lines.en: Yes, I do judo and a little rowing too.
lines.roman: Ne, yudodo hago jojeongdo jogeum haeyo.

lines.learner: 유도면 유도, 조정이면 조정, 다 좋아해요.
lines.en: Judo or rowing, I love them all.
lines.roman: Yudomyeon yudo, jojeongimyeon jojeong, da joahaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The final is still ahead. We're expecting a medal too.
lines.en: I want to win gold and become the champion.

lines.beaver: 나중에 프로 선수가 될 생각도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Are you thinking of going pro later?
lines.beaver_roman: Najunge peuro seonsuga doel saenggakdo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 꼭 프로 선수가 되고 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, I really want to become a pro.
lines.roman: Ne, kkok peuro seonsuga doego sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You also won an award last year, right?
lines.learner: 네, 신인상 수상은 큰 힘이 됐어요.
lines.en: Yes, winning Rookie of the Year gave me a big boost.
lines.roman: Ne, sininsang susangeun keun himi dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Lastly, a word for your fans, please.
lines.en: Thanks for cheering. I'll win the final too.

lines.beaver: 네, 결승에서도 좋은 결과 있기를 바랍니다.
lines.beaver_en: Great, I hope you get a good result in the final.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, gyeolseungeseodo joeun gyeolgwa itgireul baramnida.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll do my best!
